# Design Guide

<!-- Generated by CodePress style analysis. -->

SECTION 1: Primary Styling System
‣ Brand feel / mood: Minimal Create-React-App demo page with centered layout, plain sans-serif text, a dark header bar, and a handful of bright accent colors used to demo the loader.
‣ Plain CSS — every component imports a sibling `.css` file (`App.css`, `index.css`, `Watermark.css`) with hand-written class selectors; no Tailwind, no CSS-in-JS, no preprocessor.
‣ Breakpoints found in the repo: none defined. No `@media` queries exist in any CSS file.

SECTION 2: Other Styling Signals
‣ Plain CSS class selectors: ~100% of styling.
‣ Inline `style` props in JSX: 0%.
‣ CSS-in-JS / Tailwind / SCSS / CSS Modules: 0%.
‣ Evidence: `.App-header { background-color: #222; height: 150px; padding: 20px; color: white; }`
‣ Evidence: `.optionTextInput { height: 34px; width: 170px; font-size: 18px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px; }`
‣ Evidence: `import './App.css';` then `<div className="App">` in `src/App.js`.

SECTION 3: Repo-Level UI Context
‣ Framework: React 16 (class components, `react-dom` `ReactDOM.render`, no hooks).
‣ Language split: JavaScript only (no `.ts`/`.tsx`; Babel preset `react-app`).
‣ UI libraries: none. The only UI code is the in-repo `DotDotDotLoader` component plus a `Watermark` component.
‣ Pre-processors: none (`.css` only; `postcss-flexbugs-fixes` + `autoprefixer` configured via webpack, no `.scss`/`.less`). CSS-in-JS libraries: none.
‣ State libraries: none. Local `this.state` in class components only.
‣ Color palette:
  - Header surface: `#222` (dark) with `color: white` text (`.App-header`).
  - Accent red: `#e53030` (`.redStyle`).
  - Accent green: `#63ba1b` (`.greenStyle`).
  - Accent purple: `#a22dbc` (`.dotStyle`).
  - Switch on-state blue: `#2196F3` (`.slider` checked).
  - Switch off-state neutral: `#ccc` (`.slider` default).
  - Watermark magenta: `#ff0084` (`.deploy`); watermark text `#000` (`.hello`, `.watermark`).
  - Tokens live as raw hex literals inside `src/App.css` and `src/Watermark.css`; no CSS custom properties, no theme file.
‣ Typography:
  - Base family: `sans-serif` set on `body` in `src/index.css` (no specific webfont).
  - Watermark uses `Roboto Mono, monospace` at `font-weight: 500` (not imported anywhere — relies on system fallback).
  - Scale in use: ad-hoc px and em values — `1.5em` (`.App-title`), `large` keyword (`.App-intro`), `18px` (`.optionTextInput`), `20px` (`.redStyle`), `100px` (`.dotStyle`). No shared scale.
  - Conventions: header text uppercased via `text-transform: uppercase` on `.deploy` and `.hello`; otherwise default case.
‣ Spacing & layout:
  - Spacing: hand-picked px values, no base unit. Common values seen: `4px`, `5px`, `20px`, `30px`, `50px`.
  - Container widths: `.inputContainer { width: 50% }`, `.textContainer { width: 60% }`, `.bodyContainer { width: 100% }`. No max-width caps.
  - Primitives: flexbox via raw CSS (`display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center`) and `justify-content: space-around`. No grid, no utility classes.
‣ Shape & elevation:
  - Corner radius: `border-radius: 34px` on `.slider.round` (pill) and `50%` on its thumb. No radius elsewhere — inputs and `.textContainer` are square with `border: 1px solid`.
  - Depth: flat. No `box-shadow` is used to elevate surfaces; the only `box-shadow` is a 1px focus ring on the toggle slider (`box-shadow: 0 0 1px #2196F3`).
‣ Component patterns:
  - Header bar: `<header className="App-header">` → `.App-header { background-color: #222; height: 150px; padding: 20px; color: white; }` with an `<h1 className="App-title">` at `font-size: 1.5em`.
  - Text input: `<input className="optionTextInput" type="number" />` → `.optionTextInput { height: 34px; width: 170px; font-size: 18px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px; }` paired with a plain `<label>` sibling, both wrapped in `<div className="input">` (column flex).
  - Toggle switch: `<label className="switch"><input type="checkbox" /><span className="slider round"></span></label>` — 70×34 px track, `#ccc` off / `#2196F3` on, 26×26 px white thumb translated 36 px on `:checked`, 0.4s transition.
  - Demo card: `<div className="textContainer">` → `border: 1px solid; width: 60%; padding: 20px; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 30px;` — square-cornered, no shadow, no background fill.
  - Loader output: `<span className='dotDotDotLoader'>` renders bare text dots; styling is inherited from the parent (`font-size`, `color`), so callers tint and size via their own class (e.g., `.dotStyle { font-size: 100px; color: #a22dbc; }`).

SECTION 4: Guidance for Downstream LLM
‣ Do keep all styling in a sibling `.css` file imported by the component (e.g., `import './Foo.css'`) and target via `className`; don't introduce Tailwind, CSS Modules, styled-components, or inline `style={{}}` props.
‣ Do let `DotDotDotLoader` inherit `font-size` and `color` from its parent container — its own element has no styles, so size and tint it via the wrapping class, never by passing style props.
‣ Do reuse the existing accent literals (`#e53030`, `#63ba1b`, `#a22dbc`, `#2196F3`, `#ff0084`) and the dark header `#222` rather than inventing a new palette; there is no theme file or CSS custom property layer to extend.
‣ Don't add `@media` breakpoints or responsive utilities — the layout is desktop-only with percentage widths (`50%`, `60%`); match that pattern instead of introducing a mobile tier.
‣ Don't add `border-radius` to inputs, cards, or buttons — only the toggle slider is rounded (`34px` pill, `50%` thumb). Keep new surfaces square with `border: 1px solid` like `.textContainer`.
‣ Don't add `box-shadow` for elevation — the UI is flat; depth comes from 1 px borders and the `#222` header bar only.
‣ Do write new layouts with raw flexbox (`display: flex`, `flex-direction`, `justify-content`, `align-items`) and px-based `margin-bottom` spacing in multiples of 10 (10/20/30/50), matching `.bodyContainer`, `.inputContainer`, and `.textContainer`.
